blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Accounting is the language of Czarnikow's numbers. Today's lesson is "Thank You for Your Payment". It gives you short, simple sentences to use with the finance team.

You will learn to be polite. When a client pays, you say "thank you". You can also say "we appreciate your prompt payment". These words are kind, and they help your work.

Go slowly. One step at a time. English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts. You can do it!

items.q: What is the lesson about today?
options: How to make a big sale
items.why: "Today's lesson is 'Thank You for Your Payment'."

items.q: Who do you use these sentences with?
items.why: "short, simple sentences to use with the finance team."

items.q: What do you say when a client pays?
items.why: "When a client pays, you say 'thank you'."

items.q: The text says "go slowly, one step at a time". This suggests that the writer wants you to…
items.why: Inferência: "go slowly" mostra que o objetivo é aprender com calma, sem pressa.

items.q: "English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts." The writer would most likely AGREE that…
options: English is only for the finance team
you can learn English with a positive attitude
you should give up if it is hard
items.why: Inferência: a frase é um incentivo — foca no que você CAN (consegue) fazer.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie falando com um novo estagiário. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hello! Welcome to the accounting team. My name is Sophie. I am happy to help you today.

Our team is small, but we work well. When a client sends money, we say thank you. It is polite, and it is kind.

Let me show you. When the payment is fast, we say "thank you for your prompt payment". When we are happy, we say "we appreciate your support". These are short and easy. You can use them every day.

Please say the words with me. Thank you. Appreciate. Prompt. Kind. Support. Very good! Try again. Do not worry about small mistakes.

Go slowly. One step at a time. That is how good accountants work. I am here to help you. You can do it!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Who is Sophie talking to?
options: A new trainee on the accounting team
items.why: "Welcome to the accounting team… I am happy to help you today."

items.q: What does the team say when a client sends money?
items.why: "When a client sends money, we say thank you."

items.q: What does Sophie ask the trainee to do with the words?
items.why: "Please say the words with me."

items.q: When Sophie says "do not worry about small mistakes", she wants the trainee to feel…
items.why: Inferência: ela encoraja o estagiário a não ter medo de errar.

items.q: How would you best describe Sophie?
items.why: Inferência: ela repete devagar, encoraja e ajuda — é gentil e paciente.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "We appreciate your payment." To appreciate means to…
items.why: Appreciate = agradecer, ser grato por algo.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Thank you for your ___ payment. It arrived very fast."
items.why: Prompt = rápido / pontual; combina com "arrived very fast".

items.q: "That is very kind of you." Kind means…
items.why: Kind = gentil, atencioso.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Thank you for your ___ during this busy week."
items.why: Support = apoio; é o que agradecemos em uma semana difícil.

items.q: "Thank you for your help." Thank you means…
items.why: Thank you = obrigado(a): usamos para agradecer.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples do dia a dia do time financeiro. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "I will follow up on the payment tomorrow." To follow up means to…
items.why: Follow up = dar seguimento, checar de novo mais tarde.

items.q: "Thank you. I will get back to you soon." This means I will…
items.why: Get back to (someone) = retornar, responder depois.

items.q: "The manager needs to sign off on this payment." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o aval.

items.q: "We will sort out the invoice this morning." To sort out means to…
items.why: Sort out = resolver, arrumar um problema.

items.q: "Thank you for your help — please reach out if you need me." To reach out means to…
items.why: Reach out = entrar em contato, procurar alguém.
